excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a paleontologist, long blonde hair, tanned skin, wearing a white sun hat. Wears a light pink blouse worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, white shorts and pink hiking boots.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_1, in her white sun hat, chips away small chunks of buff chalky limestone matrix to map out the paddle shape of a short-necked pliosaur, Brachauchenius. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
